candidates.statement: While posterior cervical screw systems 3 must comply with the special controls, 4 it is not expected that manufacturers of devices already on the market as of May 1, 2019, would need to submit new 510(k)s, 510(k) amendments, or add-to-files to demonstrate conformance with the special controls. 5
candidates.context: C. Posterior Cervical Screw Systems Class and Special Controls Paragraph (b) of §888.3075 establishes the class and special controls for posterior cervical screw systems. D. Posterior Cervical Screw System Classification Regulation Effective Date The classification rule became effective May 1, 2019.
